messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual cross-region steering activity detected. APAC->EU request steering weight jumped from 20% -> 80% in last 3m. Error rate for APAC origins -> eu-west increased to 11%. Auto-fallback triggered. Pager: @sre_oncall_jay

sre_oncall_jay: on it. looking at console now, pulling recent steering policy updates.

sre_oncall_jay: telemetry: latency p50 APAC->EU is 1.2s -> 2.9s, p95 spiking. error spikes are mainly 502/504 from our edge proxies.

ops-lead_maria: anyone make a routing policy change around 12:18 UTC? I see a rollout event in the policy controller at 12:17:58.

netops_pete: deploy-bot shows a config push at 12:17:55 from pipeline `steer-config` (job id 8132). PR 4242 merged 12:16 by @product_sophie.

product_sophie: that was a small weighted steering tweak for canary tests, intended to move 10% -> 20% for apac. didn't expect 80%. investigating.

sre_oncall_jay: ok suspected cause: controller applied weights incorrectly. can we snapshot current policy? sending inspect command:

sre_oncall_jay: ```
# admin api
curl -X GET "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/steer/policies/apac" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

netops_pete: output shows: `weights: {eu: 0.8, apac: 0.2}` but rollout metadata expected incremental steps. controller logs show a retry loop re-applying full spec after a partial failure.

ops-lead_maria: that smells like a memcache race on the policy controller. i've seen similar when leader election flaps. grabbing controller logs now.

sre_oncall_jay: customer impact? cs_amy?

cs_amy: seeing ~12% elevated errors across APAC customers. Support queue: 23 tickets referencing timeouts/502s since 12:20. Top impacted tenants: SkylineFin, MarketWave. SLA pageviews show 6 incidents flagged.

product_sophie: omg, that was my canary. I rolled it back immediately at 12:18 but apparently rollback triggered a full spec apply that overwrote weights to 80/20.

ops-lead_maria: mitigation plan: 1) pin steering to eu:0.6 apac:0.4 (temporary) 2) throttle controller writes 3) restart policy-controller leader to break retry loop. Who can execute pin now?

netops_pete: i can run the pin. performing safe write with dry-run then apply.

netops_pete: ```
# pin weights to reduce sudden flips
curl -X PATCH "https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/steer/policies/apac" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"weights": {"eu": 0.6, "apac": 0.4}, "meta": {"manual_pin": true}}'
```

deploy-bot: runbook step 2: confirmed leader restart required. scheduling restart of policy-controller on controller-3.

sre_oncall_jay: applying temporary pin now. will monitor.

netops_pete: pinned weights applied. controller returned 200.

sre_oncall_jay: monitoring metrics... error-rate APAC -> EU down from 11% -> 3.2% over 3m. latency p95 improving. :white_check_mark:

cs_amy: support update drafted: "We identified a routing configuration regression causing elevated errors for some APAC customers. We've applied a temporary steering adjustment to reduce impact. Engineering investigating root cause."

product_sophie: root cause hypothesis: controller retry logic + a deploy race caused delta to be interpreted as absolute. filing issue and PR to add stronger compare-and-swap on writes.

ops-lead_maria: next steps: 1) keep pin for 2h, 2) restart policy-controller leader once stable, 3) run canary with instrumentation and small step increments, 4) post-incident RCA. I'll open incident ticket and assign owners.

sre_oncall_jay: handing off to night oncall in 40m. leaving monitoring alerts on for latency and error% and a quick rollback playbook pinned in the incident ticket.

cs_amy: notified affected customers (SkylineFin/MarketWave) and provided ETA: engineering follow-up within 4 hours.

netops_pete: controller logs excerpt: ```
2026-03-15T12:17:55Z INFO applying policy step 3
2026-03-15T12:17:56Z ERROR write conflict: expected version 42 got 39
2026-03-15T12:17:56Z INFO retrying full apply
2026-03-15T12:17:57Z INFO applied weights {eu:0.8,apac:0.2}
```

product_sophie: adding more tests to pipeline to catch full-spec apply on partial changes.

ops-lead_maria: documenting temporary mitigation steps in runbook. please add command snippets you used.

netops_pete: added. leaving a follow-up ticket to reduce controller write retries and add cmp-based writes.

sre_oncall_jay: last check before handoff: APAC error-rate stable at 2.9%, latency trending down. keeping pager tasks active.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and status set to "mitigated". Postmortem scheduled.

product_sophie: thanks team. i'll own the change to the canary pipeline and coordinate with netops for safer rollouts.

cs_amy: closing customer comms loop after RCA.

sre_oncall_jay: handing off to tomorrow's morning oncall @sre_oncall_lee at 3967894760. please review alerts.

ops-lead_maria: good job all. we'll follow up with RCA and timeline for permanent fix. :thumbsup:
